notes.title: Update 1.0.17
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646525/84f8be2048b9b199838697c5259af1827afb03a1.png[/img]

1.0.17 Update complete


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646525/45db5c072ebf2f247161eae32ca17023678c6b5a.png[/img]

1. Add event scene skip function

When the event scene comes out, you can skip it now!


2. Add new achievements

We've added achievements that are naturally achieved in line with the story flow.
Those who have played the game before will also be able to achieve their achievements by checking the progress of the game without having to play from the beginning again

3. Modification of other small components

The update to be a good game will continue in the future.

tags.feature: 1. Add event scene skip function
2. Add new achievements
